correctness.rationale: Full finite-dimensional Ornstein--Uhlenbeck Lyapunov equation is stable by energy decay and endpoint observability. Exact solution of its 21 symmetric equations gives the displayed rational flux and verifies all 36 residual entries. Derivative factors with a single changing-sign term, and strict negative quadratic discriminant makes denominator positive. Twelve independent SciPy Lyapunov solves agree to under 7e-15; finite checks supplement the all-parameter symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Central isotope/impurity mass is a natural one-parameter heat-flux design variable in the smallest chain with a distinct interior particle. The exact unique optimum is a nontrivial global all-positive-friction structural rule, independent of bath damping and thermal contrast, with sharp universal bound on mass enhancement. It identifies a measurable mass-matching effect and a motivated benchmark for testing larger chains, not an arbitrary finite enumeration or parameter relabeling.
